caption: The video showcases nine glossy colored spheres—two red, two green, two blue, two yellow and one orange—loosely arranged on a bright near-white surface. Each casts a soft gray shadow that shifts in step with the bodies above it. Throughout the excerpt the spheres repeatedly squash, stretch and dent rather than holding their shape. The upper red flattens into an oblate teardrop, while the left green and central blue take on lumpy, jagged silhouettes. The right and lower yellow spheres compress and round again in turn. Meanwhile the spheres drift in different directions rather than as a rigid cluster, the top red sliding toward the upper edge and the far-right yellow easing outward toward the border. The central and upper-middle spheres, by contrast, sink downward into place. The translation is already underway on the first frame, and the squashing continues to evolve as the clip ends.
